stanza: And she told me her weaving
But I was greedy, I was vain
And I forced her to working

hourly.line: We were poorly, our fortunes fading hourly
stanza: We were poorly, our fortunes fading hourly
And how she vowed me, she could bring it back
But I was greedy, I was vain and I forced her to weaving
On cold loom, in a closed room, with down wove
